maddeler.e:
نستعجب (form X)
# نَسْتَعْجِبُ (nastaʕjibu) /nas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
# نَسْتَعْجِبَ (nastaʕjiba) /nas.taʕ.d͡ʒi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
# نَسْتَعْجِبْ (nastaʕjib) /nas.taʕ.d͡ʒib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَعْجَبَ (istaʕjaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
